title: Fix: cooperative-stop self-block on same-session sub-worker
summary: request_agent_stop on a sub-worker claimed under the requester's own session used to halt the requester too: orch-stop.sh sent only session_id to /should-stop, and stopSignalFor(session) tripped on ANY claimed task's agent having stop_requested — so the driver (same session as its worker) got exit-2'd on its own set_status/TaskCreate. Fix keys the stop to the CALLING agent: PreToolUse carries agent_id for subagents but NOT the main/driver thread (confirmed via Claude Code hook docs). orch-stop.sh now forwards agent_id as &agent=; stopSignalFor(session,{actor,hook:true}) halts only when stop_requested[actor] (the worker itself), so the driver (no actor) runs on. In-process loop heartbeat keeps the old session-scoped path (hook:false) so it still self-exits. A human task-CANCEL stays session-scoped. Files: ~/.claude/orchestrator/daemon.js (stopSignalFor + /should-stop route), hooks/orch-stop.sh. Verified by /tmp/orchfix/stop-test.sh (7/7: worker exit2, driver exit0+TaskCreate allowed). NOTE: live :8787 daemon still runs pre-patch code — needs a restart to take effect (classifier blocked me from restarting shared infra).
